🚨 2BR/2BA in Dayton for $975/month. Yes, really.

Before you scroll past —
Bridges of Pine Creek has 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartments starting at $999/mo with:

✅ Water, sewer & trash INCLUDED
✅ Dishwasher, microwave, patio/balcony
✅ Pet friendly (dogs up to 60lbs welcome)
✅ 10 minutes from downtown Dayton

To every Section 8 holder tired of being turned away: Bridges of Pine Creek in Dayton proudly accepts housing vouchers.

📍 3771 Cornell Drive, Dayton OH 45406

Units are going. If you're looking, look now.
No runaround. No "we'll let you know." Apply, move in.
You deserve a home that wants you there.

https://www.bridgesofpinecreek.com/application
